key_id.description:
Stable identifier for this key, used in delete and rotate
requests.

key_prefix.description: First eight characters of the secret, safe to display.

BillingSubscription.description: Information about billing for a repository.

Commit.description:
A git commit identified by SHA and by its linear height in the
source repository. `height` is submitted by the client because
the server has no access to the repo graph; it lets analytics
reason about distance between commits without walking history.

display_name.description: Human-readable label shown in the dashboard.

expires_in_days.description:
Number of days until the key expires. Omit for no expiry.
When present, must be in the range 1..=3650.

secret.description:
The full secret. Returned once at creation/rotation only and
never recoverable afterwards.

challenge.description: The exact challenge value returned by `/initiate`.

signature.description:
Base64url-encoded (no padding) ed25519 signature over
`b"testquorum-exchange-v1:" || challenge_bytes`. Signed with
the private key whose public half was sent to `/initiate`.

api_key.description:
Bearer token to send as `Authorization: Bearer <api_key>` on
subsequent requests. Shown once and never recoverable.

key_id.description:
Stable identifier for the minted credential (for audit /
future revocation surfaces).

public_key.description:
Base64url-encoded (no padding) 32-byte ed25519 public key. The
matching private key never leaves the workflow runner and is
used to sign the exchange request.

repository.description:
`owner/repo`, exactly as `$GITHUB_REPOSITORY` reports in the
workflow.

workflow_run_id.description:
`$GITHUB_RUN_ID` — globally-unique identifier for the workflow
run.

artifact_filename.description:
The single file the artifact must contain. Its body must equal
the challenge value verbatim (no trailing whitespace).

artifact_name.description: The artifact name the workflow must use when uploading.

challenge.description:
Single-use challenge string the workflow must include in its
uploaded artifact.

PublicKeyOwnerKind.description:
Where a key is logically owned. `account` keys are managed under
the user's account settings; `repo` keys are managed under a
specific repository's settings; `workflow` keys are minted by the
GitHub Actions auth flow and not user-manageable.

PublicKeyPermission.description:
Permission level granted to a user-managed API key. Persistent keys
can only be `read` or `read_write`; `admin` is reserved for the
OAuth-issued UI session.

oneOf.description: Grants access to a specific non-empty list of repository ids.

Grants access only to resources owned by a specific GitHub
Actions workflow run. Minted exclusively by
`POST /github/auth/exchange`; rejected if supplied to the
user-managed key creation endpoint.

PublicKeyScope.description: The set of repositories an API key can act on.

QuoteResponse.description: A pricing quote response containing subscription tiers and pricing information.

trial_available.description:
True when this repository is eligible for the introductory free trial.
Once a trial has ever been started on the repo this becomes false and
never returns to true.

RepoState.description: The subscription state of a repository.

expires_in_days.description:
Number of days until the new secret expires. Omit for no
expiry. The new value replaces the old one — rotation does not
inherit the previous expiry. Must be in the range 1..=3650 when
present.

Run.description: The CI run that produced a test result.

oneOf.description:
Pre-review check: `head` is the proposed branch tip,
`merge_base` is where the branch diverged from its target.

Pre-land check: `head` is a candidate merge commit,
`merge_base` is its first parent on the destination branch.

Deprecated: use `PostLand` instead. Post-merge check: `head` is the
new tip of the destination branch, `merge_base` is its parent (the
previous tip). This variant is retained for backward compatibility but
will be removed in a future release.

Post-land check: `head` is the tip of the branch at the time the job
ran, `branch` is the branch name, and `trigger` is the reason it ran.

RunKind.description:
What kind of run this is, together with the merge-base commit it
is being compared against.

onboarding_seen.description: Whether the user has completed the first-time onboarding flow.

results.description:
Test instances to submit. Each entry must carry a UUIDv7 the
client mints once and reuses across lifecycle transitions
(Discovered → Running → terminal). A resubmit of a known
`id` lands iff the new state is a forward progression from
the stored one, or an idempotent re-submit of the same
variant; non-forward resubmits (e.g. Passed → Failed, or a
backwards move) are rejected with 409. The same rule applies
to multiple entries for the same `id` within a single batch.
At most 1024 entries per request.

ids.description:
UUIDs of the test instances that were created, in the order
they appeared in the request.

TestManager.description: The test manager that produced a result. One of `cargo`, `nix`, `treefmt`, or `custom:<name>` for an in-house runner.

TestResultDoc.description:
A single test instance within a CI run.

Submitting the same `id` again replaces the existing record, so
clients model the test lifecycle by emitting state transitions
against a UUID they mint once when the test is first observed.

id.description:
Stable identifier for this test instance. Must be a UUIDv7
(RFC 9562 §5.7); other UUID versions are rejected.

test_name.description: Fully-qualified test name as reported by the runner.

oneOf.description: Registered by the runner; has not yet started.
Ran and produced a negative result.

Could not run to completion due to a problem outside the
test itself (panicked harness, missing fixture, runner
crash).
Cancelled by the runner (e.g. job cancellation).

TestState.description:
Lifecycle state of a test instance. Each variant carries every
timestamp the test has reached, so transitions never lose
information when the doc is overwritten on resubmit.
